mapper.select: SELECT id, name, position_x, position_y, width, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM bookshelf ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookshelf (name, position_x, position_y, width, sort_order) VALUES (#{name}, #{positionX}, #{positionY}, #{width}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE bookshelf SET name = #{name}, position_x = #{positionX}, position_y = #{positionY}, width = #{width}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
